lines.en: - You wanna buy a moon rock? - A moon rock?
- You mean from the actual moon? - Where else are you gonna find a moon rock?
- Now I feel stupid. - It's all right.
I'll get the moon rock out of my car.
- Nice! - You know, if you put your ear up to it,
- you can hear space. - Get out. Try it.
- Huh? - I... I don't hear anything.
That's because to hear space, you gotta bend over.
Put it up to your ear.
